Confirmed: Sophie is right. For Scheldemond the guaranteed salary starts on day one, also for part-timers. Version 2.0 of the sick leave procedure and the Client X addendum are the references; version 1.0 is superseded and should no longer be shared. Lucas, please configure day one with AB-10.

Tom, no harm done, but please check the version before linking a procedure.

Katrien
